title: Unexpected item
description: Milo had a disagreement with the self-checkout.

scenes.pov: POV: your friend just got back from the shops

lines.text: The self-checkout just accused me of stealing a banana.
No! I scanned it. It said unexpected item.
It's a supermarket. Bananas are the whole point!
A light started flashing. Everyone turned around.
I apologised to it. Out loud. Twice.
It printed a receipt this long. Mostly warnings.
You scanned, bagged, and got told off. That's a shift.
Wait. Do I work there now?
Unpaid. And you're on again Saturday.
